question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           t.calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as city_quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN city_quarter_sales END) AS q4_2019_sales,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN city_quarter_sales END) AS q4_2020_sales,
        (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) * 100.0 / q4_2019_sales as pct_change
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_growth
    WHERE pct_change >= 20.0
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           SUM(product_quarter_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(product_quarter_sales) as quarter_total
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT ps.prod_id,
           ps.calendar_quarter_id,
           ps.product_quarter_sales,
           qt.quarter_total,
           ps.product_quarter_sales * 100.0 / qt.quarter_total as share_pct
    FROM product_sales ps
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON ps.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END) as share_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) as share_2020,
        (MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END)) as share_point_change
    FROM product_shares ps
    GROUP BY ps.prod_id
),
product_ranks AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           total_sales,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_percentile
    FROM product_totals
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.prod_id,
        pr.total_sales,
        pr.sales_percentile,
        COALESCE(psc.share_2019, 0) as share_2019,
        COALESCE(psc.share_2020, 0) as share_2020,
        COALESCE(psc.share_point_change, 0) as share_point_change
    FROM product_ranks pr
    LEFT JOIN product_share_change psc ON pr.prod_id = psc.prod_id
    WHERE pr.sales_percentile >= 0.8
)
SELECT * FROM final_result
ORDER BY share_point_change ASC
